column1: # Stage S10 H3d, fifth and last Mission Creator crate: the workspace (the editor page and its
# canvas mount, the docked chrome around the map, the Editor Layers outliner, the inspectors, the
# full-screen dialogs, the read-only review workspace and the editor's top-level tests) becomes
# crates/frontend/workspaces/mission_creator_workspace. The editor folder becomes the crate's
# `src`, its module tree `lib.rs`, and its README the source tree README; the editor's remaining
# documentation moves to its mirror under documentation/crates/frontend/workspaces/
# mission_creator_workspace. The prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the moved folder and one
# `mission_creator_workspace::` row scoped to the app's source.
